messages:
Anya Rao: kicking off an RFC/PRD thread for the staged rollout + experiment plan for session-routing and version pinning. want acceptance criteria + rollback rules before i send to eng.
Michael Chen: thanks. high-level ask: support per-customer routing policies, canary by percent + customer segment, and a default fallback path. keep it low-risk.
Zain Patel: +1. we should require: (1) routing decision trace_id in logs, (2) variant tag in traces, (3) dark traffic mirror for new model for 24h before traffic ramp.
Lina Gomez: suggest metrics: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token cost delta, and prompt-level quality via eval set (we'll run 200 prompts). define thresholds.
Anya Rao: tentative ramp schedule: 0.5% (10m), 1% (30m), 5% (1h), 20% (2h), 50% (4h). each step required: no spike in 5xx >2x baseline OR p95 latency > baseline+100ms. rollback immediate on breach.
Michael Chen: clarify: baseline measured over last 24h for that route/model combo. also require quality gate: if eval failure rate (regression on golden prompts) increases by >3 percentage points at any step, pause and rollback.
Zain Patel: operational guardrails: session pin TTL = 24h by default, but we must support per-customer override and migration window. provide auto-unpin after 7 days for experiments.
Lina Gomez: let's capture acceptance criteria block for PRD:

- Functional: routing API accepts policy {segment, percent, model_version, pin_ttl, fallback} and returns route with variant tag.
- Observability: every request logs routing_decision, model_version, variant, trace_id.
- Safety: dark mirror enabled for 24h before ramp; canary abort conditions applied at each step.
- Quality: golden-set eval not worse than baseline by >3pp (stat test with alpha=0.05).
- Rollback: automated if 5xx rate >2x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency > baseline+100ms for 10m OR quality gate breached.

Michael Chen: add: experiment analysis output must include lift/decline in token cost per 1k requests and example failure traces.
Anya Rao: engineering notes request: a sample rollout policy JSON and a k/v config name. here's a strawman policy snippet to include in RFC:
```
{
 "policy_name": "staged_v2_routing",
 "segments": ["beta_customers","all_users"],
 "steps": [{"pct":0.5,"duration_m":10},{"pct":1,"duration_m":30},{"pct":5,"duration_m":60}],
 "pin_ttl_hours":24,
 "dark_mirror_hours":24,
 "fallback_model": "v1-stable"
}
```
Zain Patel: good. also require variant headers: X-RW-Variant and X-RW-Routed-By in responses so downstream telemetry can correlate.
Lina Gomez: experiment design: include control vs treatment tags, randomization seed, and minimum sample size per step (N>=5000 requests or 2h whichever is larger) to power the eval.
Anya Rao: decision checklist for launch (PRD -> ENG -> Release):
- PRD approved by product + security
- RFC reviewed by eng-runtime + infra
- Observability dashboards pre-provisioned
- Dark mirror run completed
- Rollback automation tested in staging
- Customer communication + opt-out path documented

Michael Chen: timeline ask: aim for internal rollout RFC review by EOD Fri, eng scoping next week, pilot w/ 3 beta customers in 3w.
Zain Patel: dev question: do we allow multi-version pins per session? i.e., pin user A to v1 and user B to v2 simultaneously.
Anya Rao: yes. must support multi-version pins with clear conflict resolution: newest pin wins. include TTL semantics in PRD.
Lina Gomez: can we add a lightweight sanity check endpoint that returns current routing policy for a customer? useful for support.
Michael Chen: +1, include /routing/lookup?customer_id=...
Anya Rao: last: permissions — only product/ops + approved SRE can create global ramps, customers can request per-customer pin via support flow.
observability-bot: NOTE: dashboard template created: /dashboards/staged-rollout-template (placeholder). :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deploy-check: staging automation tests passed for routing service at 1768456895.
Anya Rao: great — i'll fold these into the PRD and attach the RFC. please add any missing edge cases. tagging @Lina @Michael for final acceptance criteria signoff. :rocket:
